energy_accounting.study_energy_disclosure: Built-in processor energy counters and three-OS deterministic replay across 25,500 frames.

claims.statement: Conventional software burns needless time and electricity unpacking text and recalculating answers it already solved.
Immutable fingerprint-chained logs and bitemporal indexes let any machine replay exact past states without guesswork.
Zero-copy memory-mapped lookup stores turn repeated work into sub-microsecond reads costing under two microjoules.
claims.paper_section: 2. The design space of autonomous coding

claims.statement: Headline outcome: 0.325 Microsecond Lookup · 1.77 Microjoules · 0 Drift (Built-in processor energy counters and three-OS deterministic replay across 25,500 frames.)

easy_read.easy_title: Exact Logs and Microsecond Memory Reads
three_points_one_idea_sentences: This study is about exact logs and microsecond memory reads.
Conventional software burns needless time and electricity unpacking text and recalculating answers it already solved.
Immutable fingerprint-chained logs and bitemporal indexes let any machine replay exact past states without guesswork.
Zero-copy memory-mapped lookup stores turn repeated work into sub-microsecond reads costing under two microjoules.
Key result: 0.325 Microsecond Lookup · 1.77 Microjoules · 0 Drift.
Built-in computer chip counters recorded the energy used.
